frontend vitest: 2 passed; npm run build succeeds

commands_run.command: npm install; npm run build; npm test (frontend)

design_decisions.decision: Ref-count derived from per-symbol connection sets (not an integer counter) so it cannot drift or go negative; rejected a separate counter.
ConnectionManager takes an on_disconnect callback wired to SubscriptionManager.disconnect so failed sends also release subscriptions; rejected cleanup only in ws handler.
Upstream injected via factory(settings, on_tick, get_symbols) in create_app; with no FINNHUB_API_KEY the default factory returns None (no connection) rather than looping against a rejecting server.
Tick persistence uses a bounded queue plus background batch writer that drops on overflow; rejected awaiting inserts in the tick path.
Webhook header is X-Signature-256 = sha256=hex(HMAC(secret, raw body)); body is canonical compact sorted JSON.
Percent-change rule compares against the oldest in-window price from tick timestamps; history only kept for symbols with rules.
Frontend uses npm install in CI (no lockfile committed) and no tsconfig since vite build uses esbuild; rejected adding files not in the spec list.
Secret static scan lives in test_webhooks.py rather than a new test file, to stay within the file list.

implementation.self_critique: Real asyncpg/Redis/TimescaleDB paths (db.py, redis_cache.py) are not exercised by tests since they need live services; SQL and hypertable creation are unverified. Real websockets.connect framing is only covered via the fake. Reconnect backoff reset happens on successful connect only. No tsc type-check is run in CI.
